_doc: Training loops for Map 2 Totenhafen (UPDATE 07 QA, T-103). Same format as routes_map00.json / routes_map01.json. Validate: gravelight/tools_src/route_tool.tscn -- --map=map02 --validate; test_map02_edges checks every point sits on the navmesh.

routes.label: round the harbourmaster's hut
routes.notes: The Quay (spawn): the ring round the harbourmaster's hut (x 10-18, z 10-17), the beached cutter to the north-east and the parapet to the north kept 2 m off; the two quay windows (S) and the stage windows (N) all open onto the ring.

routes.label: round the gut lines
routes.notes: The Fish Cannery: the ring round the two gutting lines (x -22 to -6, z 13.3-19.7), south of the conveyor and north of the brine tanks and the can pallets; Second Wind on the north wall and Marathon on the south are both one step off the ring.

routes.label: the pump-stair corner
routes.notes: The Pen Hall's north-east apron corner (x 40-51, z 34-41): the open slab between the coffin pallets (x 35-40) and the pump-stair landing, kept north of the z 41.5 region seam and off the stair.
